}}'''Corelna''' is an [[Aiel]] [[Wise One]].

== Appearance ==
She has green eyes and her flaxen hair is graying.

== Activities ==
She is one of the Aiel Wise One's to camp outside [[Cairhien]] after leaving the [[Aiel Waste]].

It can be assumed that during the [[Last Battle]] she fights in [[Thakan'dar]] Valley along the other Wise Ones.
